thread:
Sam (CEO): Thanks for the great all-hands discussion. Wanted one short thread to capture follow-ups on why we won/lost and immediate asks from leadership. Keep replies concise.

Marco (VP Product): From roadmap POV the top signals I care about: why customers pick Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, and the single most common blocker we can remove quickly.

Leah (Customer Success): TL;DR from CS: wins = simple onboarding + detailed example integrations (Slack, Zendesk), visible latency guarantees. Losses = unclear private deployment checklist, pilot billing surprises, and audit evidence gaps for regulated customers.

Ethan (Sales): Adding specifics from outbound: two logos lost last month because they needed "air-gapped" install docs + an SOC2 attestation copy during the RFP. We shouldnt make AEs chase that.

Nina (Solutions): Customers repeatedly ask for an "audit bundle" (KMS integrations doc, SOC2 excerpt, example network diagram) we can hand them. 30d: produce audit bundle draft.

Ravi (Eng): Tech note: Private deploy friction is often infra setup (static IPs, routing, certs). We can template terraform + Docker Compose snippets. 60d: minimal infra templates.

Marco (VP Product): Proposed 30/60/90 plan: 30d = private quickstart + audit bundle draft; 60d = infra templates + AE one-pager for RFPs; 90d = pilot SLA options + self-serve checklist in Console.

Leah (Customer Success): Also flag: customers said pricing during pilot felt opaque. Request: publish an example pilot invoice and an explainer doc. 30d for a FAQ page.

Ethan (Sales): Agree. Also want one short rebuttal card for AEs: "When customers ask about air-gap, heres the short answer + next step." Will draft.

Sam (CEO): Leadership ask: owners for each item by COB tomorrow and a KPI we can monitor (e.g., pilot cycle time, RFP win-rate).

Marco (VP Product): I'll take private quickstart + owner assignment.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-5401: "Private quickstart + audit bundle" assigned to Marco, due 30d.

Leah (Customer Success): @Ethan please DM the three recent RFPs where this came up. Ill attach redacted examples to the bundle.

Nina (Solutions): Ill start the audit bundle skeleton in Google Drive and invite CS/Sales/Legal.

Ravi (Eng): FYI tagging eng-infra to help with terraform snippets. Will start spike for 2 days.

Sam (CEO): Good. Short-term focus is reducing pilot turnaround and RFP friction. If someone hits blockers, call me in.

Marco (VP Product): Will post owners + timeline tomorrow AM. Thanks all. :rocket:
